title: Origin story: Icarus
description: Icarus was the son of Daedalus, the master craftsman imprisoned with him in the labyrinth of Crete by King Minos. Daedalus fashioned wings of feathers and wax for them both, warning his son to fly a middle course — neither too low where sea spray would weigh the wings, nor too high where the sun would melt the wax.
